title: Drop Node 18 support - align with Vite 7 requirements
body:
Vite 7.3.1 requires Node.js 20.19+, but the project still specified `node: ">=18"` and CI tested on Node 18.x, causing test failures with ESM module loading errors.

## Changes

- **CI workflow**: Remove Node 18.x from test matrix
- **package.json**: Update engines to `node: ">=20"`
- **plugin-kanban/tsconfig.json**: Remove `rootDir` to eliminate TypeScript warnings when importing from workspace dependencies

## Breaking Change

Node 18.x is no longer supported. This aligns package requirements with the reality that Vite 7 (already in use across all packages) requires Node 20+.
